An '''[[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. At one point, a [[Unidentified Nikto senator/Legends|Nikto senator]] rallied the other senators to not show weakness, and this Aqualish agreed. Some time after, the Aqualish was seemingly attacked along with numerous other senators, noticeably holding his stomach in pain.
